name: GhostSeparator
description: Headless visual and semantic divider. useGhostSeparator owns orientation and decorative semantics; GhostSeparator is the thin unstyled element. Themed styles live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element. Omit to get hr when horizontal and div when vertical. li is valid inside a list.

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true, sets role=none so the line is omitted from the accessibility tree. Defaults false so native hr and menu/toolbar grouping keep separator semantics.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis of the line. Vertical has no native element, so the default as becomes div.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The single rendered element selected by as.
